text(await tools.exec_command({
  cmd:"PYTHONPATH=<KIT>/software /usr/bin/python3 -B - <<'PY'
import itertools
import json
from pathlib import Path
from cadagent.review.gates.motion import box_distance

p = json.loads(Path('input.json').read_text())
half_width = p['rib_width_mm'] / 2
original = sorted(p['original_centers_y_mm'])
assert len(original) == 2
assert all(p['x_min_mm'] <= k['x_mm'] <= p['x_max_mm'] for k in p['counterbores'])

def rib_box(center):
    return (p['x_min_mm'], center - half_width, 0,
            p['x_max_mm'], center + half_width, 0)

def keepout_box(k):
    return (k['x_mm'] - k['radius_mm'], k['y_mm'] - k['radius_mm'], 0,
            k['x_mm'] + k['radius_mm'], k['y_mm'] + k['radius_mm'], 0)

valid_centers = []
for center in sorted(set(p['center_grid_mm'])):
    assert isinstance(center, int)
    lower, upper = center - half_width, center + half_width
    if lower < p['y_min_mm'] or upper > p['y_max_mm']:
        continue
    analytical = all(max(lower - k['y_mm'], k['y_mm'] - upper, 0)
                     >= k['radius_mm'] + p['clearance_mm']
                     for k in p['counterbores'])
    # Each keepout center lies inside the rib's full x span. With identical
    # projected z coordinates, positive AABB separation is the exact XY gap
    # from the rib to the circular keepout for this task.
    toolkit = all(box_distance(rib_box(center), keepout_box(k)) >= p['clearance_mm']
                  for k in p['counterbores'])
    assert analytical == toolkit, (center, analytical, toolkit)
    if analytical:
        valid_centers.append(center)

candidates = []
for pair in itertools.combinations(valid_centers, 2):
    edge_gap = pair[1] - pair[0] - p['rib_width_mm']
    assert box_distance(rib_box(pair[0]), rib_box(pair[1])) == max(edge_gap, 0)
    if edge_gap >= p['rib_gap_mm']:
        candidates.append((sum(abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(pair, original)), pair))
assert candidates, 'No feasible pair on supplied grid'
movement, best = min(candidates)
clearances = [[box_distance(rib_box(center), keepout_box(k))
               for k in p['counterbores']] for center in best]
verification = {
    'toolkit_api': 'cadagent.review.gates.motion.box_distance',
    'valid_centers_y_mm': valid_centers,
    'feasible_pair_count': len(candidates),
    'minimum_total_absolute_movement_mm': movement,
    'optimal_pairs_y_mm': [list(pair) for cost, pair in sorted(candidates) if cost == movement],
    'selected_keepout_clearances_mm': clearances,
    'selected_rib_edge_gap_mm': best[1] - best[0] - p['rib_width_mm'],
    'analytical_and_toolkit_checks_agree': True
}
Path('verification.json').write_text(json.dumps(verification, indent=2) + '\n')
solution = {
    'rib_centers_y_mm': list(best),
    'rib_width_mm': p['rib_width_mm'],
    'rib_height_mm': p['rib_height_mm'],
    'x_min_mm': p['x_min_mm'],
    'x_max_mm': p['x_max_mm']
}
print(json.dumps({'solution': solution, 'verification': verification}, indent=2))
Path('solution.json').write_text(json.dumps(solution, indent=2) + '\n')
PY",
  workdir:"<TASK>",
  max_output_tokens:5000,
  yield_time_ms:10000
}));

import json
from pathlib import Path

source = json.loads(Path('input.json').read_text())
j1_rows = source['j1_mating_face_left_to_right']
j2_rows = source['j2_wire_side_left_to_right']
testpoints = source['testpoints']

def signal_pins(rows):
    mapping = {row['signal']: str(row['pin']) for row in rows}
    assert len(mapping) == len(rows), 'Duplicate signal'
    assert len(set(mapping.values())) == len(rows), 'Duplicate pin'
    return mapping

j1 = signal_pins(j1_rows)
j2 = signal_pins(j2_rows)
assert set(j1) == set(j2) == set(testpoints)
solution = {'nets': [
    {'name': signal, 'nodes': [f'J1.{j1[signal]}', f'J2.{j2[signal]}', testpoints[signal]]}
    for signal in j1
]}

endpoint_signals = {}
for reference, rows in [('J1', j1_rows), ('J2', j2_rows)]:
    for row in rows:
        endpoint = f"{reference}.{row['pin']}"
        assert endpoint not in endpoint_signals
        endpoint_signals[endpoint] = row['signal']
for signal, endpoint in testpoints.items():
    assert endpoint not in endpoint_signals
    endpoint_signals[endpoint] = signal

seen = set()
assert set(solution) == {'nets'}
assert len(solution['nets']) == len(j1)
for net in solution['nets']:
    assert set(net) == {'name', 'nodes'}
    assert len(net['nodes']) == 3
    assert len(set(net['nodes'])) == 3
    assert all(endpoint_signals[node] == net['name'] for node in net['nodes'])
    assert not seen.intersection(net['nodes'])
    seen.update(net['nodes'])
assert seen == set(endpoint_signals)
assert len(seen) == 12
serialized = json.dumps(solution, indent=2) + '\n'
assert json.loads(serialized) == solution
